The '''Holder of the Keys''' is the chief of servants in the [[Sun Palace]] in [[Cairhien]]. This official is identified by a ring of heavy silver keys worn at the waist. It's said that no matter who rules Cairhien, the Holder of the Keys rules the Sun Palace. The position was last known to be held by [[Corgaide Marendevin]].
